AGENTS · PROJECT

Software that consults: context as the new moat

When software is cheap to build, depth of context, owning the workflow and delivering outcomes become the moat.

Has anybody already built software that consults instead of just executing?

THE PROJECT · 5 SCREENS

The question

When the cost of creating software collapses, what still keeps customers?

The approach

Write the business down so an agent can act on it — goals, ground principles, customers, constraints — in simple files the harness reads before it understands, acts and checks.

The tradeoff

Context is powerful only if it’s maintained; stale goals or principles make an agent confidently wrong.

What to take with you

The old moats were building and owning the interface. The new ones are context, workflow and outcomes.
